docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A young man's journey from Baalbek to the streets of New York and back to Syria: the first novel in English by an Arab-American writer.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Ameen Rihani (1876–1940), The Book of Khalid, 1911. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
